Hello

I'm Meghann Barsalou, a Red Seal Carpenter based out of Prince Rupert, BC.

My approach is anchored in two fundamental principles: dedication and authenticity. I weave these principles into every endeavor.

I also prioritize transparent communication and exceptional client relations, coupled with a keen ability to observe and comprehend the environment I operate in.

Whenever possible, I personally choose materials, allowing their natural qualities to steer the creative journey. This harmonious interaction between the journeyperson and the material breathes life into extraordinary projects.

My guiding values will tell you more on my approach. Read my bio to get a better sense of who I am. Or see what I offer with my carpentry services.

Guiding values

The principles behind every build

If you can dream it, I can build it. Definitely. But what I believe distinguishes me from others in this industry is how I approach each project through my core values.

Courage

Courage is one of my main values for many reasons; courage to move forward in my chosen profession as an industry leader, courage to construct that which does not yet exist, and courage to be myself.

Craft

I aspire to avoid the quick-fix methods in my craft that are often prevalent in modern contracting. While I can work within a range of different budgets, I never cut corners or compromise on quality. I take pride in my craft and believe that through selecting high-quality materials, each piece of wood tells a different story.

Connection

Developing a solid client relationship is a cornerstone of my carpentry approach. I emphasize open communication, actively listen, and thoughtfully consider my clients' needs. My goal is to grasp their vision and ensure they are completely satisfied with the final result.

Longevity

Having longevity as one of my forefront core values goes beyond simply completing a task but I believe encompasses my deep sense of responsibility, effort and attention to detail I bring to each project to ensure structurally sound and long lasting work.

Leadership

I strive to view each project with a clear vision and purpose, considering the functionality, aesthetics, and client's preferences while designing. Leadership plays a huge role in my projects through setting goals, taking initiative, and bringing people together.

Learning

By having Learning as one of my core values, I am able to continuously grow and cultivate my skills in a personal and professional way that furthers my abilities as a carpenter no matter the task at hand. I value sharing this knowledge with others around me.

Craftsmanship is my passion. I pour my heart into each piece I create.
